messages:
maya: FYI I'm kicking off marigold-8b bring-up today. Need a short smoke focusing on quant parity, RoPE phase sanity, and KV-cache hit behavior. Prefer quick targeted probes over long evals.

sam: @maya acknowledged. I'll run q4h and q4f quick passes at 4096/8192 contexts. Will capture logits diffs, kvcache stats, and perf. Keeping runs <30m each. :white_check_mark:

jon: FYI saw a weird KV miss spike on a previous 8B run — second token in a chunk occasionally shows kv_hit=false for a head then recovers. Sharing a tiny trace soon. Could be tile-alignment or phase wrap.

kai: Add a micro quality check: use marigold-smoke-200 prompt set, compare token logits at positions 1/20/100, and compute token-level divergence rate. Also run a single-thread deterministic seed. Keep runtime flags: `--disable-autobatch` and test both `--kv-compat=legacy` and `--kv-compat=rotary-shift`.

eva: Spinning up a small dedicated A10 instance now. Will run int8 + q4h quickments. ETA ~25m; will post run ids.

runtime-bot: deploy request accepted for job marigold-smoke-1719910000 on pool-small (1xA10G)

runtime-bot: job marigold-smoke-1719910000: container ready, CUDA 12.1, libs validated

sam: My quick checklist: \
- runtest: `runtest --model marigold-8b --quant q4h --ctx 4096 --suite marigold-smoke-200 --compare logits`
- variants: `--kv-compat=legacy` and `--kv-compat=rotary-shift`
- metrics: p50/p90 latency, tok/s, memory, kvcache_hits/misses/evictions
- artifact: full traces + phase-dump

jon: snippet from prior trace (reproduced locally):
```
[2024-08-02T09:12:03Z] step0 token=11 kv_hit=true
[2024-08-02T09:12:03Z] step1 token=12 kv_hit=false  <-- unexpected single-step miss
[2024-08-02T09:12:03Z] step2 token=13 kv_hit=true
```

maya: That single-step miss could be a RoPE phase table serialization quirk when quantized. Prioritize: 1) deterministic single-thread; 2) FP32 vs Q4H logits compare; 3) rotary phase table dump pre/post quant.

kai: Running phase-table extract: `python tools/rotary_phase_dump.py --model marigold-8b --quant=q4h --out /tmp/marigold-rotary.npz` and a float32 baseline. Will diff the angle arrays.

eva: Run ids posted: marigold-q4h-1719910455, marigold-int8-1719910501. Starting legacy vs rotary-shift pairs now.

sam: Quick pass results (initial): q4h vs fp32 -> token divergence ~0.15% at early tokens, spikes to ~1.1% at token ~80 on a small subset (20 prompts). kvcache showed occasional evictions coincident with chunk boundary crossings. Attaching artifact link.

maya: Noted. Let's run a forced alignment pad experiment: add `--kv-pad=16` and see if spike disappears. If padding eliminates miss spikes, we can recommend kv_pad=16 in catalog as a temporary workaround.

jon: I added temporary logging to dump `kv_idx` per attention head and will share results in ~15m. If we see index misalignment, we'll attempt a kernel-level alignment patch.

kai: Opening ticket INF-2291 to track: reproduce steps, diffs, phase dumps, recommended `kv_pad=16` fallback, and suggested follow-ups for kernel alignment. Marking P1 for canary pause if divergence >0.5% at token 10.

eva: Artifacts uploaded: s3://redwood-artifacts/marigold/q4h-1719910455.tar.gz and s3://redwood-artifacts/marigold/int8-1719910501.tar.gz

runtime-bot: job marigold-q4h-1719910455: finished (success). artifacts available.

sam: Short summary after pad experiment: with `--kv-pad=16` the single-step kv misses drop to near-zero in our test subset. Token divergence FP32 vs Q4H reduced to 0.08% early tokens and 0.3% at token 80. Perf overhead minimal (~2% throughput loss).

maya: Good signal. Next steps: 1) add kv_pad recommendation to model catalog entry for marigold-8b; 2) keep kernel alignment ticket INF-2291 open; 3) run a slightly larger eval (500 prompts) overnight before candidate rollout.

kai: I'll document exact runtest commands and attach diffs in INF-2291.

eva: Kicking off overnight batch (500 prompts) with both q4h and fp32; will post final divergence numbers tomorrow morning.

maya: Thanks team. If overnight shows regression >0.5% at early tokens, we hold canary and escalate to eng-runtime @oncall-runtime. Otherwise we can progress to candidate rollout with kv_pad flag and a follow-up kernel fix. Wrapping up — will post final verdict in ~12h. :rocket:
